idea: Find the longest set of letters that appear in both texts in the same order, not necessarily next to each other. Cell (i, j) holds the answer for the first i letters of one text and the first j of the other. If the two letters match, add one to the cell up and left; if not, take the larger of the cell above and the cell on the left. Walking back from the corner reads the letters.
useWhen: Comparing two texts or files to see what they share (the idea behind diff)
Measuring how similar two sequences are, such as DNA strings
avoidWhen: You need the fewest edits, not the shared part (use edit distance)
The texts are very long: the table needs n times m cells
